body: A stream could resolve backward references but not forward ones, so the same bytes would expand differently depending on which API read them. Parse must keep everything (round-trip guarantee); Scan must discard everything (constant memory); one function cannot be both. Measurement showed the saved cost was not real, and it found a quadratic parsing bug instead. ParseReader shipped to address the real cost (one copy instead of two).
title: Rejected: a streaming parser (Scan)
